description: CRISPRi screen deltas, sign -1 (this bundle is CRISPRa): perts[gene].delta = mean over cells of log1p(10,000 x counts / cell total) of that screen's cells of the perturbation minus its own control mean, over this bundle's genes in bundle order (null where unmeasured there); source: CRISPRi Perturb-seq screen ReplogleWeissman2022_K562_gwps.h5ad. The screen's modality (CRISPRi) differs from this bundle's (CRISPRa), so a target's response here is expected to point the other way: multiply a target's delta by sign (-1) before using it as that target's predicted change; correlations between rows do not depend on the sign. A perturbation of several genes has a row only when every target has one: the sum of its targets' deltas.
